name: Gabor Kereszturi
description: The PLACE19 programme lists Gabor Kereszturi of Massey University jointly demonstrating satellite-data access and Google Earth Engine with Stuart Mead. His biography records GIS and geomorphology study at Miskolc, a 2014 Massey doctorate and subsequent hyperspectral-imaging research.
